Name: 7 Quests of the Hero
Overview:
A one player action adventure with comedy elements! - Seven maidens have been kidnapped and held prisoner by an evil sorcerer... Your mission is to locate and rescue them back to the safety of the castle and then keep them amused for the duration of their stay!

Hours of gameplay

Buy special items from the shop to help your quest

Buy gifts for the maidens to make them happy!

Release your inner hero!
